subject.title: [Feature]: Control UI should show compact run progress for long or multi-agent tasks

question: Should this Control UI progress strip wait for the gateway-owned session activity API in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/39127, or should maintainers accept a narrower UI-only progress strip based on existing tool/preamble events?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent API/UX boundary is a product decision because current main has partial event streams and multiple open candidate PRs.

options.title: Use gateway activity as the owner
options.body: Keep this issue open as Control UI acceptance criteria while reviewing or narrowing the gateway activity contract and linked implementation PRs.

options.title: Ship a narrow UI-only strip
options.body: Allow a smaller Control UI implementation that summarizes current tool/preamble events, accepting that it may later be replaced by the gateway activity API.

options.title: Close under the broader API issue
options.body: Treat the broader session activity issue as the only canonical tracker and close this UI-specific request after preserving its acceptance criteria there.

recommendation.title: Use gateway activity as the owner
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as Control UI acceptance criteria while reviewing or narrowing the gateway activity contract and linked implementation PRs.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows active work in both the chat composer and session-thread surfaces, making this the strongest available routing signal for the product/API choice.
